Control Objective: Ensure user accounts are authorized managed reviewed and removed when no longer required
Current Implementation: User provisioning and termination processes exist but recurring account reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Account inventory provisioning records termination records and access review evidence
Gap Identified: Inactive or unnecessary accounts may remain enabled
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly account reviews and automate termination access removal

Control Objective: Limit users to the minimum privileges required for job responsibilities
Current Implementation: Role-based access control is implemented but privileged-access reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Privileged account inventory business justification and review approvals
Gap Identified: Users may retain elevated permissions longer than necessary
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Control Objective: Ensure personnel receive recurring security awareness training
Current Implementation: Annual security awareness training is provided
Evidence Expected: Training completion reports and awareness materials
Recommended Remediation: Continue annual training and phishing simulations

Control Objective: Ensure security-relevant events are logged across critical systems
Current Implementation: Centralized logging is enabled for critical systems
Evidence Expected: SIEM screenshots log source inventory and logging configuration
Recommended Remediation: Continue validating critical log source coverage

Control Name: Audit Record Review Analysis and Reporting
Control Objective: Ensure audit records are reviewed for suspicious or inappropriate activity
Current Implementation: Logs are collected but recurring review evidence is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Log review records incident tickets and escalation evidence
Gap Identified: Recurring security log reviews are not consistently documented
Recommended Remediation: Define and document recurring log review procedures

Control Objective: Maintain approved secure baseline configurations for systems
Current Implementation: Configuration standards exist but review evidence is incomplete
Evidence Expected: Configuration baselines hardening standards and approval records
Gap Identified: Baselines may not reflect current security requirements
Recommended Remediation: Review and approve configuration baselines annually

Control Objective: Ensure security configuration settings are defined implemented and monitored
Current Implementation: Secure configuration standards are used but some exceptions are not centrally tracked
Evidence Expected: Configuration standards exception records and system settings evidence
Gap Identified: Security configuration exceptions may remain unresolved

Control Objective: Ensure critical systems and data are backed up regularly
Current Implementation: Regular backups are performed and monitored
Evidence Expected: Backup logs backup policy and monitoring records
Recommended Remediation: Continue monitoring backup success and failures

Control Objective: Ensure systems can be restored after disruption
Evidence Expected: Restoration test reports recovery logs and corrective-action records
Gap Identified: The organization lacks consistent evidence that backups can be restored
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly restoration testing and document results

Control Name: Identification and Authentication of Organizational Users
Control Objective: Verify users before granting access to systems
Current Implementation: Unique user accounts and authentication controls are implemented
Evidence Expected: Identity records authentication policy and account inventory
Recommended Remediation: Continue enforcing unique identities and authentication requirements

Control Objective: Require stronger authentication for privileged users
Current Implementation: MFA is enabled for some privileged accounts but not all
Evidence Expected: MFA configuration privileged account inventory and exception records
Gap Identified: Privileged access is not consistently protected by MFA
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all privileged accounts and document approved exceptions

Control Objective: Require MFA for applicable non-privileged remote or sensitive access
Current Implementation: MFA is used for remote access but coverage is not consistently validated
Evidence Expected: MFA coverage report remote-access inventory and authentication settings
Recommended Remediation: Review MFA enrollment and enforce MFA for applicable remote access

Control Objective: Ensure incidents are identified contained eradicated and recovered from
Evidence Expected: Incident response plan incident tickets and response procedures
Recommended Remediation: Continue annual review of incident response procedures

Control Objective: Test incident response capability on a recurring basis
Current Implementation: Tabletop exercises are not performed consistently
Evidence Expected: Tabletop exercise report participant list and lessons learned
Gap Identified: Incident response procedures are not regularly validated
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual tabletop exercises and track corrective actions

Control Objective: Assess threats vulnerabilities likelihood impact and risk to systems
Evidence Expected: Risk assessment report risk register and review records
Recommended Remediation: Continue recurring risk assessments and management review

Evidence Expected: Vulnerability scan reports scan schedules and asset coverage
Recommended Remediation: Continue recurring scanning and coverage validation

Control Objective: Identify and remediate software and system flaws
Current Implementation: Vulnerability findings are tracked but some high-risk items exceed target timelines
Evidence Expected: Remediation tickets patch records vulnerability aging reports and exception approvals
Gap Identified: High-risk vulnerabilities may remain open beyond acceptable timelines
Recommended Remediation: Enforce severity-based remediation SLAs and document risk acceptance for exceptions

Current Implementation: Approved encryption is used for sensitive traffic
Evidence Expected: TLS configuration encryption standards and network security evidence

Control Objective: Manage cybersecurity risk from external suppliers and service providers
Current Implementation: Vendor assessments occur but recurring reassessment is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Vendor questionnaires risk assessments contracts and reassessment evidence
Gap Identified: High-risk suppliers may not be reassessed consistently
Recommended Remediation: Perform annual security reassessments for high-risk suppliers and track remediation
